verdict.rationale: Unit's docs describe API-based access to accounts, transactions, cards, payments, and compliance/operational data (unit-docs-1, unit-docs-5, unit-docs-25), which supports the 'clean API instead of screen-scraping' half of the story, but there is no evidence of an MCP surface or agent-specific integration, and probes for a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404s (unit-probe-2, unit-probe-3), suggesting the API is not yet packaged for easy machine/agent consumption. Missing for 10: MCP server or agent-oriented API description, publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec, and explicit documentation of unified read access to pending activity and documents.
